filled.cb-brief-title: Boiling water and steam safety — one kitchen demonstration
filled.cb-brief-goal: Explain, in their own words, why steam burns worse than boiling water, and show the one safe place to stand while an adult pours hot water into a cup.
filled.cb-brief-start: Has watched water boil with an adult; can read short sentences.
filled.cb-brief-reading: Year 4, short sentences with a few technical words explained inline
filled.cb-brief-materials:
kettle
metal spoon
heat-proof jug
thermometer
filled.cb-brief-exclusions:
no open flame
no child handling the kettle
filled.cb-brief-supervision: An adult pours and stands between the child and the kettle; the child watches from a marked line.
